articles.title_en: Careworn: The Economic History of Caring Labor
articles.title_cn: 疲惫不堪：照料劳动的经济史
articles.abstract_en: Economists ignore caring labor since most is provided unpaid. Disregard is unjust, theoretically indefensible, and probably misleading. Valuation requires estimates of time spent and the replacement or opportunity costs of that time. I use the maintenance costs of British workers, costs which cover both the material inputs into upkeep and the domestic services needed to turn commodities into livings, to isolate the costs of paid domestic labor. I then impute the value of unpaid domestic labor from these market equivalents, and aggregate across households without domestic servants. Historically, unpaid domestic labor represented c. 20 percent of total income, a contribution that suggests the need to revise some standard narratives.
articles.abstract_cn: 经济学家忽视照料劳动，因为大部分照料劳动是无偿提供的。这种忽视是不公正的、理论上站不住脚的，并且可能具有误导性。估价需要估算所花费的时间以及该时间的重置成本或机会成本。我利用英国工人的维持成本（这些成本既涵盖维持生活所需的物质投入，也包括将商品转化为生活所需的家庭服务）来分离有偿家务劳动的成本。然后，我根据这些市场等价物推算无偿家务劳动的价值，并在没有家庭仆人的家庭中进行汇总。从历史上看，无偿家务劳动约占总收入的20%，这一贡献表明有必要修正一些标准叙事。

articles.title_en: Leaving the Enclave: Historical Evidence on Immigrant Mobility from the Industrial Removal Office
articles.title_cn: 离开飞地：来自工业迁移办公室关于移民流动性的历史证据
articles.abstract_en: The Industrial Removal Office funded 39,000 Jewish households to leave enclave neighborhoods in New York City from 1900 to 1922. Compared to neighbors with the same baseline occupation, program participants earned 4 percent more ten years after relocation. These gains persisted to the next generation. Benefits increased with more years spent outside of an enclave. Participants were more likely to speak English, and married spouses with less Jewish names. More Jewishly-identified men (as measured by own names) were more likely to return to the city. We contextualize these results with new national evidence on Jewish economic and cultural assimilation.
articles.abstract_cn: 工业迁移办公室在1900年至1922年间资助了39,000个犹太家庭离开纽约市的飞地社区。与基线职业相同的邻居相比，项目参与者在迁移十年后收入高出4%。这些收益持续到了下一代。在飞地外度过的年数越多，收益越大。参与者更可能说英语，并与犹太名字较少的配偶结婚。更具犹太身份认同的男性（以自身名字衡量）更可能返回城市。我们用关于犹太经济和文化同化的新全国性证据来对这些结果进行背景化分析。

articles.title_en: Classicism and Modern Growth: The Shadow of the Sages
articles.title_cn: 古典主义与现代增长：圣贤的阴影
articles.abstract_en: This paper examines how the worship of ancient wisdom affects economic progress in historical China, where the learned class embraced classical wisdom for millennia but encountered the shock of Western industrial influence in the mid-nineteenth century. Using the number of sage temples to measure the strength of classical worship in 269 prefectures, I find that classical worship discouraged intellectuals from appreciating modern learning and thus inhibited industrialization between 1858 and 1927. By contrast, industrialization grew faster in regions less constrained by classicism. This finding implies the importance of cultural entrepreneurship, or the lack thereof, in shaping modern economic growth. “The humor of blaming the present, and admiring the past, is strongly rooted in human nature, and has an influence even on persons endued with the profoundest judgment and most extensive learning.” —David Hume (1754, p. 464).
articles.abstract_cn: 本文考察了古代智慧的崇拜如何影响历史中国的经济进步，在那里，知识阶层千百年来拥抱古典智慧，但在十九世纪中叶遭遇了西方工业影响的冲击。使用圣贤庙的数量来衡量269个府中古典崇拜的强度，我发现古典崇拜阻碍了知识分子欣赏现代学问，从而抑制了1858至1927年间的工业化。相比之下，受古典主义约束较少的地区工业化增长更快。这一发现意味着文化企业家精神（或缺乏这种精神）在塑造现代经济增长中的重要性。“责备现在、赞美过去的幽默，深深植根于人性，甚至对具有最深刻判断力和最广博学识的人也有影响。”——大卫·休谟（1754，第464页）。

articles.title_en: Art and Markets in the Greco-Roman World
articles.title_cn: 希腊罗马世界的艺术与市场
articles.abstract_en: We study art markets in the Greco-Roman world to explore the origins of artistic innovations in classical Greece and the mass production of imitative works in the Roman Empire. Economic factors may have played a role, on one side fostering product innovations when a few rival Greek city-states competed, outbidding each other to obtain higher-quality artworks, and on the other side fostering process innovations when a large integrated market promoted art trade across the Mediterranean Sea. The evidence on art prices is consistent with this. Literary evidence on classical Greek painting from V–III centuries BC (largely from Pliny the Elder) shows that the real price of masterpieces increased up to the peak of creativity reached with Apelles. Epigraphic evidence on Roman sculpture from I–III centuries AD (largely from inscriptions at the base of statues) shows that the real price of statues was stable and largely equalized across the imperial provinces.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究希腊罗马世界的艺术市场，以探索古典希腊艺术创新的起源和罗马帝国仿制作品的大规模生产。经济因素可能发挥了作用，一方面，当少数几个相互竞争的希腊城邦竞争时，它们相互竞价以获得更高质量的艺术品，从而促进了产品创新；另一方面，当一个大而整合的市场促进了地中海地区的艺术贸易时，它促进了过程创新。艺术价格的证据与此一致。关于公元前五至三世纪古典希腊绘画的文学证据（主要来自老普林尼）表明，杰作的真实价格上升到由阿佩莱斯达到的创造力顶峰。关于公元一至三世纪罗马雕塑的碑文证据（主要来自雕像底部的铭文）表明，雕像的真实价格是稳定的，并且在帝国各省之间基本持平。

articles.title_en: The Political Economy of Status Competition: Sumptuary Laws in Preindustrial Europe
articles.title_cn: 地位竞争的政治经济学：前工业欧洲的禁奢法
articles.abstract_en: Sumptuary laws that regulated clothing based on social status were an important part of the political economy of premodern states. We introduce a model that captures the notion that consumption by ordinary citizens poses a status threat to ruling elites. Our model predicts a non-monotonic effect of income—sumptuary legislation initially increases with income, but then falls as income increases further. The initial rise is more likely for states with less extractive institutions, whose ruling elites face a greater status threat from the rising commercial class. We test these predictions using a new dataset of country and city-level sumptuary laws. It is unfortunately an established fact that both men and womenfolk have, in utterly irresponsible manner, driven extravagance in dress and new styles to such shameful and wanton extremes that the different classes are barely to be known apart. —Nuremberg Ordnance of 1657, Quoted in Hunt (1996)
articles.abstract_cn: 基于社会地位规范服饰的禁奢法是前现代国家政治经济的重要组成部分。我们引入了一个模型，捕捉普通公民的消费对统治精英构成地位威胁的概念。我们的模型预测收入具有非单调效应——禁奢立法最初随收入增加而增加，但随着收入进一步增加而下降。对于榨取性制度较弱的国家，其统治精英面临来自新兴商业阶层的更大地位威胁，初始上升更可能发生。我们使用新的国家和城市层面禁奢法数据集来检验这些预测。不幸的是，一个既定事实是，无论男女，都以极其不负责任的方式，将服饰的奢侈和新款式推向如此可耻和放荡的极端，以至于不同阶层几乎无法区分。——纽伦堡法令，1657年，引自亨特（1996）

articles.title_en: Urban Political Structure and Inequality: Political Economy Lessons from Early Modern German Cities
articles.title_cn: 城市政治结构与不平等：近代早期德国城市的政治经济学启示
articles.abstract_en: What was the impact of urban political structure on preindustrial wealth inequality? I document that more closed political institutions were associated with higher inequality in a panel of early-modern German cities. To investigate the mechanisms behind that macro-relationship, I construct a unique individual-level panel dataset on personal wealth and political office-holding in the city-state of Nördlingen (1579–1700). I employ a difference-in-differences setting to show that political elites enriched themselves substantially, increasing inequality. To address endogeneity concerns, I exploit the Thirty-Years’ War as a shock to elites’ potential for enrichment from public office. Officials manipulated this crisis to enrich themselves further.
articles.abstract_cn: 城市政治结构对工业化前财富不平等有何影响？我记录到，在近代早期德国城市的面板数据中，更封闭的政治制度与更高的不平等相关联。为了探究这一宏观关系背后的机制，我构建了一个关于个人财富和政治官职持有的独特个体层面面板数据集，涵盖帝国城市诺德林根（1579-1700年）。我采用双重差分设定来表明，政治精英大幅自我致富，加剧了不平等。为解决内生性问题，我利用三十年战争作为对精英从公职中获利潜力的冲击。官员们操纵这场危机以进一步自肥。

articles.title_en: Measuring the Partisan Behavior of U.S. Newspapers, 1880 to 1980
articles.title_cn: 衡量美国报纸的党派行为，1880 至 1980
articles.abstract_en: In this paper, we study newspaper partisan behavior and content, which we measure using coverage of and commentary on partisan activities, institutions, and actors. We use this measure to describe the levels of relative partisan behavior during the period 1880 to 1900, and to describe changes over the period 1880 to 1980. We find that, on average, newspapers were initially highly partisan, but gradually became less partisan over time. Importantly, we find as much change after the 1910s as before, which contributes to the existing literature that focuses on changes in the nineteenth and early twentieth centuries. We also investigate words and phrases that had negative or positive partisan connotations in particular periods. Finally, we examine whether some of the common hypotheses offered in the literature can account for the changes. The initial findings suggest that these explanations can only account for part of the decline.
articles.abstract_cn: 在本文中，我们研究报纸的党派行为和内容，并通过对党派活动、机构和参与者的报道和评论来衡量。我们使用这一衡量标准来描述1880至1900期间相对党派行为的水平，并描述1880至1980期间的变化。我们发现，平均而言，报纸最初的党派倾向性很强，但随着时间的推移逐渐变得不那么党派倾向。重要的是，我们发现1910之后的变化与之前一样多，这有助于现有文献关注十九世纪和二十世纪初的变化。我们还调查在特定时期具有消极或积极党派含义的单词和短语。最后，我们研究文献中提供的一些常见假设是否可以解释这些变化。初步调查结果表明，这些解释只能解释部分下降的原因。
